what: DNV's alpha factors for weather-restricted marine operations: OPWF = alpha x OPLIM (the forecast must stay at or below OPWF over the reference period TR = TPOP + TC). Transcribed from DNV-OS-H101 (October 2011) Sec.4 B700, Tables 4-1 to 4-6, page 32-33, and checked against the text 2026-10-06. ONE definition: apps/janela/audit/alpha.py and the workability runner both read this file.

source.title: DNV-OS-H101 Marine Operations, General (Offshore Standard), October 2011
source.licence: DNV copyright; the PDF is pinned by hash, kept in the git-ignored cache, never redistributed; the table values are transcribed as facts with their location
source.successor: DNVGL-ST-N001 (current edition 2023-12) carries the alpha-factor scheme; its tables were not compared here

rules.B501: Marine operations with a reference period (TR) less than 96 hours and a planned operation time (TPOP) less than 72 hours may normally be defined as weather restricted.
rules.B402: If TPOP uncertainties and required time for contingency situations is not assessed in detail the reference period should normally at least be taken as twice the planned operation period, i.e. TR >= 2 x TPOP.
rules.B704: The expected uncertainty in the weather forecast should be calculated based on statistical data for the actual site and the operation schedule, i.e. TPOP. Guidance note: The alpha-factor should be calibrated to ensure that the probability of exceeding the operational environmental limiting criteria (OPLIM) with more than 50% is less than 10-4.
rules.B705: In the North Sea and the Norwegian Sea the alpha-factor should normally be selected according to the relevant Table 4-1 through Table 4-5 [...] a guideline for other offshore areas.
rules.interpolation: linear between design-Hs columns (1, 2, 4, >= 6 m); rows are steps 'TPOP <= x h' with no interpolation stated; design Hs below 1 m: case by case (Note 3)

4-1.name: base case: one forecast (Level C) or the mean of forecasts

4-2.name: Level B: the highest forecast of at least two recognised sources

4-3.name: Level A with a meteorologist at site

4-4.name: forecast calibrated by monitoring (D300); TPOP > 24 h: Table 4-1 or 4-2

4-5.name: monitoring and Level A with a meteorologist at site; TPOP > 24 h: Table 4-3

4-6.name: recommended maximum alpha for wind when no reliable data is available (B712)
